'''Eugen Pavel''' is a [[Romania]]n scientist and inventor of the ''[[Hyper CD-ROM]]''.

Pavel graduated with a [[physics]] [[Bachelor's degree|degree]] from the [[University of Bucharest]] in 1976. He was awarded the [[Romanian Academy]] Prize in 1991 and obtained his [[doctorate]] in Physics from the Romanian Institute of Atomic Physics in 1992.<ref name=tripod>[http://ponteuxin.tripod.com/science.html  The Center of Excellence for Advanced Technologies "Euro-Asia"] ''The [[Johannes Gutenberg|Gutenberg]] era sets - the Pavel era begins.''</ref>

== Hyper CD-ROM ==
The Hyper CD-ROM is a proposed [[3D optical data storage]] medium 
which uses ''[[Fluorescent Multilayer Disc]]''<ref name=pcworld>[http://www.pcworld.com/article/id,31724-page,1/article.html PC World, 12 October 2000] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061205041945/http://pcworld.com/article/id,31724-page,1/article.html |date=5 December 2006 }} Hyper CD-ROM Packs Terabytes</ref> technology with a reported capacity of 1[[Petabyte|PB]] and a theoretical capacity of 100 [[Exabyte|EB]]<ref name=theregister>[https://www.theregister.co.uk/2012/01/19/inphase_storex/ The Register, 19 January 2012] ''Holographic storage's corpse twitches''</ref> on a single disc. 

In an interview about his work on the Hyper CD-ROM, Dr. Pavel stated that "the research for this project is 100% personal, [and] so is the support for experiments."<ref name=cdfreaks>{{Cite web |url=http://www.cdfreaks.com/news/10000-GB-can-be-stored-on-one-Hyper-CD-ROM.html |title=cdfreaks.com's translation of a Romanian article on the Hyper CD-ROM |access-date=2006-12-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070523195351/http://www.cdfreaks.com/news/10000-GB-can-be-stored-on-one-Hyper-CD-ROM.html |archive-date=2007-05-23 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
